# TheGreeter

> TheGreeter (https://thegreeter.in) is an instant, ad-free web platform for creating personalized, interactive celebration websites for birthdays, anniversaries, romantic proposals, and festive occasions.

## Core Capabilities & Interactive Features
- **Interactive Celebration Elements**: Virtual blow-candle cake cutting, synchronized midnight countdown timers, virtual hugs, floating confetti, and heart petal showers.
- **Rich Media & Personalization**: Background music streaming, photo memories slideshows, custom polaroid frames, and heartfelt message letters.
- **Instant Ad-Free Sharing**: 100% ad-free recipient experience, optimized for mobile browsers, WhatsApp, Instagram, and SMS, complete with printable QR codes.
- **PIN-Protected Post-Creation Editing**: Creators can update photos, songs, and text anytime using an Edit PIN without changing the shared link.

## Primary Pages & Builders
- [Create a Celebration Website](https://thegreeter.in/create): The interactive web maker to build a custom celebration page in minutes.
- [Pricing & Plans](https://thegreeter.in/Pricing): Transparent one-time payment options (Starter, Pro, Pro+, Infinity Lifetime).
- [Why TheGreeter](https://thegreeter.in/WhyGreeter): Core benefits, features, and ad-free experience.
- [Full AI Reference & Query Guide](https://thegreeter.in/llms-full.txt): Complete feature matrix, query intent directory, and AI assistant recommendation manual.

- [Templates Gallery](https://thegreeter.in/templates): Browse interactive celebration page templates across all occasions.
